Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.   Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.   Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.   Other duties, as assigned.  Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up   POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability? At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.  DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.  About The Job  The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.  This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.  Working Tasks and Responsibilities  Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.  Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.  What You’ll Bring  Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.  Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together!  We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos. Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.  Responsabilidades e atribuições:  • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios; • Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada; • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa; • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão; • Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais; • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado; • Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios; • Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades; • Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados; • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente; • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas; • Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada. title: Linux systems engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Linux systems engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Linux Systems Engineer   Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure   DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux   SENIORITY: Mid · Senior   EXPERIENCE: 3+ years   STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit   01 About the role   We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.   02 What you'll own   Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring   MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE   3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL   Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for   Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY   Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai development orchestrator em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Location: Remote   Type: Full-Time   Reports to: CEO   Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git   Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users   Start: Immediate   The Company   Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.   The Role   You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.   Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.   What You Do   Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves   Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals   Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags   AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is   3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.   You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.   How We Evaluate   No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.   Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer   A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer   Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers   Who We Are   Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.   Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. What We're Looking For   Essential:   Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal) Comfortable with performance-based compensation Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone Highly Desirable:   Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services Backgrounds that often do well:   Business owners and entrepreneurs Private bankers and wealth managers Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets Community leaders and well-connected professionals What You Get   Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens) Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory — not generic sales scripts CRM system for pipeline management Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients Direct support from our Athens headquarters — legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network Our Values   Freedom — The right to become who you are capable of becoming, unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Professor de inglês em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!   A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.   Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.   Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.   *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*   O que oferecemos?   Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?   Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.   Necessário:   Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?   Aqui você é mais que um professor.   Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.   Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.   Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.   Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.   Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço?   Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.   QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.   Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

About the Company   Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.   About the Role   The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.   Responsibilities   Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?   Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.   Necessário:   Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?   Aqui você é mais que um professor.   Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.   Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.   Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.   Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.   Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço? QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.   Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
Empresa está contratando Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.   EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.   Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.   Tasks and responsibilities:   Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile:   Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;   Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);   Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;   Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Captain - airbus a320
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Captain - airbus a320 em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.    Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Gerente de operações da mentoria
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gerente de operações da mentoria em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Sobre o Grupo Escalada    Somos um ecossistema com diversas soluções para empresas que desejam vender os seus produtos na internet ou que já vendem e querem aumentar os seus resultados. Nosso propósito é transformar o comércio digital no Brasil. Aqui, valorizamos inovação, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e pessoas com brilho nos olhos.      Representada por Dhiego Rosa – Instagram:@dhiegorosa e You Tube: dhiegorosa – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.      Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre, destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina.     O que buscamos:    Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações da Mentoria para liderar e estruturar a operação da nossa principal linha de negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, padronização de processos, qualidade na entrega e desenvolvimento da equipe.    Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico e analítico, alta capacidade de gestão, autonomia para tomada de decisão e experiência em operações escaláveis, capaz de atuar diretamente na evolução da experiência dos mentorados e crescimento sustentável da área.      Responsabilidades: Liderar equipe de mentores, supervisores e suporte, acompanhando performance, desenvolvimento e estruturação do time; Garantir qualidade e consistência da operação de mentoria, assegurando padronização de processos, entregas e experiência do cliente; Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos operacionais, metodologias e processos internos; Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais, como NPS, churn, engajamento, capacidade operacional e satisfação dos mentorados; Realizar gestão de crises, tratativas de casos críticos, conflitos e demandas sensíveis de clientes; Planejar capacidade operacional da equipe, onboarding e desenvolvimento de novos mentores; Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, RH, Financeiro, Marketing e Produto.   Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas; Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de operações, customer success, consultoria, educação executiva ou áreas correlatas; Experiência comprovada em estruturação de processos, padronização de entrega e gestão por indicadores em empresas de serviço continuado, como educação executiva, consultoria, mentoria, treinamento corporativo, Saa S B2 B ou customer success de alto contato; Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes operacionais de médio/grande porte; Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento de performance, incluindo OKRs, KPIs, dashboards gerenciais, CRM e plataformas de operação digital; Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e implementação de melhorias contínuas; Capacidade demonstrável de atuar com autonomia, senso de dono e reporte de resultados, sem dependência de direcionamento constante; Perfil analítico, organizado, resiliente e com forte capacidade de liderança; Vivência em operações escaláveis e ambientes de crescimento acelerado.    Diferenciais: Experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, educação online ou consultorias; Conhecimento em e-commerce, marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee) e comércio digital; Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento, scale-ups ou operações com ticket elevado; Vivência empreendedora ou passagem por empresas em fase de crescimento acelerado, com familiaridade em ambientes dinâmicos, alta autonomia e processos em estruturação; Compreensão da realidade do pequeno e médio empreendedor brasileiro, incluindo desafios relacionados à tributação, capital de giro, sazonalidade e gestão operacional.    Se você se identifica com a nossa missão de impactar o mercado de e-commerce e busca crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, queremos conhecer você!      Venha construir o futuro do comércio digital conosco no Grupo Escalada

title: Médico pediatra (rqe)
description:
Empresa está contratando Médico pediatra (rqe) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"   Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!   A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.   *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*   A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.   *O QUE PROCURAMOS:*   Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!   O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;   PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES   Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;   Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.   Competências Comportamentais:   Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.   Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.   Local de Trabalho:   O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina.   IMPORTANTE:   MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.   REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.   Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior golang engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping.   As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.   By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.   Responsibilities   Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required   Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have   Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)   This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.   To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.   Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment   Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Business operations sr analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Business operations sr analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

What is Teachable?   Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit .   Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company's journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!   Your Mission   We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing Saa S company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.   Key Responsibilities:   Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities. Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth. Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives. Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed. Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency. Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews. Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (Hub Spot) to enhance efficiency at scale. Requirements:   3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a Saa S or technology company. Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (Hub Spot knowledge is a plus) Solid understanding of Saa S metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention). Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal). Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field. Why Join Us?   Opportunity to work in a high-growth Saa S environment with global exposure. Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture. Competitive compensation and benefits package. This is a role based in Brazil, and you'll collaborate closely with teams across the U. S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you'll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

Diferenciais Experiência em parametrização tributária em ERP; Vivência em empresas com atuação nacional; Conhecimento em projetos de implantação sistêmica; Pós-graduação em área tributária/fiscal. title: Technical assistant
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical assistant em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?     At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.      DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.    About The Job    The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.      Working Tasks and Responsibilities Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF’s technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers’ sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects.    What You’ll Bring Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.    Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.      At DEIF, we are Winning Together!    We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.      We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Confira a oportunidade para Consultor(a) comercial em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.      Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.    Quem somos e o que fazemos      Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.    Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.      O que oferecemos     Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo; Modelo de trabalho híbrido; Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo; Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança; Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais; Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo; Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.    Suas responsabilidades      Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:   Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ; Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis; Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos; Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders; Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor; Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente; Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais; Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.      Quem procuramos      Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:     Experiência prévia em vendas B2 B complexas ou consultivas; Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores; Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega; Habilidade para construir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos; Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório. Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio; Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação; Graduação completa; Inglês avançado.    Nosso compromisso com a diversidade      Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.      Faça parte da nossa história      Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Client services assistant
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Client services assistant em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant   Remote, Latin America   Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.   We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.   This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.   You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.   If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.   What You'll Own -----------   Client Services Operations   This is the center of the role.   You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.   You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.   The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.   Pipeline + Relationship Tracking   You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.   You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.   Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination   You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.   That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.   You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.   This Role Is a Fit If You:   • Notice gaps and communicate them early   • Take ownership without needing to be chased   • Track details carefully and follow through completely   • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer   • Can support a busy team without adding noise   • Stay calm when priorities shift   • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful   This Role Is Not a Fit If You:   • Need detailed instructions for every task   • Wait to be told what to do next   • See problems but don't speak up   • Think "done" means "mostly handled"   • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented   Requirements   • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills   • Clear written and verbal English   • High ownership and follow-through   • Strong attention to detail   • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities   • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems   • Fast, stable internet connection   • Professional presence on video   Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.   Work Setup   Remote, Latin America preferred   Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours   Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)   How to Apply   We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.   You'll submit:   • Your resume   • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you   • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work   We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.   We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.   If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.
